name: devns
description: Local-first harness for long-running agent work with feature JSON, hook gating, and HTML review.

interface.shortDescription: Run long-lived agent work through a feature JSON harness.
interface.longDescription: DevNS helps agents claim one feature, analyze requirements, verify work, record evidence, and continue through a local harness while humans review progress in HTML.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the DevNS workflow. Start uncertain sessions with `npm run devns:doctor -- --json`; initialize candidate features when needed, clarify each feature into an RFC before implementation, only claim features with approved RFCs, verify work, record evidence, and commit exactly one feature.
